0022600188.text: The Heat (3-5) visit the Golden State Warriors (5-3) for their ninth game of the season. Miami is ninth in the East and third in the Southeast, 1.5 games back, on a one-game win streak after going 1-3 at home and 2-2 on the road. Golden State, eighth in the West and 1.5 games back in the Pacific, is riding a five-game win streak, and it is without Gui Santos (knee), Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), and Moses Moody (knee surgery). The teams split their 2025-26 series 1-1, and their last meeting was a 135-112 Heat loss in San Francisco on January 19, 2026.
